reviews.text: Amazing experience, when you are with angelika, you know you are together with somebody who loves animals and loves her job, this isn't about money for her. I trust nobody else with my animals and am extremely picky about who I let interact with my animals unless I know they are animal lovers and that certainly she is. Thank you so much for your help 🙏  you are truly amazing at what you do and also are such an amazing human and individual. Take good care of your lovely kitties 😸 😇🥰
Super good dog groomer👍☺ Is a very calm person and takes the time to make the dog feel safe🙏👍Cheaper than other places too😁🙏 I recommend this female groomer Angelika at Popsypets, Ulvenveien 73👍😁 …
Very satisfied 🤎 she always takes her time with the dogs and is very careful 🐶 very cozy atmosphere …

Toffee had a deshedding session. All went well! Even though she was like most cats a bit wiggly, Angelika did a wonderful job on her. Her coat feels smoother then before and there is minimum loose fur now. Recommend!!

I highly recommend Angelica! 🐶✨
She is incredibly nice and provides a very personal service that makes both dog and owner feel safe and cared for. She is incredibly competent and skilled as a dog groomer, and always does a fantastic job with my Billy.

You can really tell that she cares about the animals and puts her soul into her work.
Highly recommended! 🫶🏻

Always a good experience at Angelika! We have used her as a hairdresser for many years both with our previous dog Casper, and with our current puppy Felix.
Angelika is very skilled and patient. She takes her time and does everything to make it a nice and fun experience for the dog.
Felix had his first haircut ever the other day, and we couldn't be more pleased! He probably also thought it was nice to get his fur off.
Easy to find centrally located in Ulven, nice premises at street level.
Highly recommended!
It was Teemo's first time at a professional dog groomer, and it was definitely a great experience. Angelika did a really good job, and we got a happy, well-groomed and good-smelling dog back❤️
Super satisfied 🥰 highly recommended! …

Extremely unprofessional. We made an appointment to get our dog's nails trimmed. The door was locked. We rang the doorbell three times because it was very cold and snowing. She looked at us and made an angry face because we rang the doorbell and still wouldn't open the door.

Amazing lady with a big heart for animals!
You really feel that she has the best interest for you and your pet, and is very talented! Thank you so much for giving my baby the best treatment and care!
Professional, clean and beautiful clinic!
I really recommend going here for the best care!

This was my first time using a groomer. I didn't think anyone could take such good care of my dogs. My beagle and golden retriever looked amazing! The only problem we had was taking them away because they loved it so much they wanted to stay. 😂❤️ The communication with the groomer, the brushing, the washing, and the trimming were all top-notch. Now I know we'll be going there every time. I wholeheartedly recommend them. ❤️
Nice hairdresser and happy dogs, recommended!
First time we have been there. Amazing service and Sirius look amazing!
Incredibly good and skilled dog groomer. We have been there with Oskar (Australian Labradoodle) twice and have been very satisfied. Highly recommended!
Very happy with the service 👍 …

Very good experience at Posypets! We booked an appointment here after a recommendation, and don't regret it for a second. We cut our 6-month-old puppy for the first time and he turned out so nice. Angelika is welcoming, knowledgeable and very nice. She is committed to understanding the dog's needs and our wishes. We will be back!
The absolute best in Oslo! Very personal service, super clean environment and a skilled and knowledgeable dog groomer!

I walked past the salon and wondered if they might sell cat food or toys that I could buy as I don't know of any other pet stores nearby. The door was locked, but I saw that there was a person inside the store. I knocked on the window and she indicated with her hands that I should wait a bit. Then I thought I could call so she wouldn't have to leave her job. The call was rejected, but I didn't know if it was a mistake or if she hung up. She tried to leave a message, but I didn't see it until I called again and she stormed over to the door and started yelling at me. I said "I just want to ask you a question, can I buy cat food here" and she said I couldn't, that she had no idea who I was and continued to yell at me. I was of course completely put out by the situation, and left this 1 star review as I don't understand how potential customers can be treated like that. About an hour later I get a voice note on message, where she threatens to report me, says she has my phone number and name and says she has video and photo surveillance. It is an absolutely incredible situation and I hope no other customers have to experience this.
Thank you
